This plot is very small, just 0.06 hectares, so I grow a minor crop here for the household. I spread some manure from our animals because it costs nothing and helps the soil, but I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot — I need that money for my larger fields. I use seeds I kept from last season, and my family will manage the work ourselves without hiring anyone. We depend on rain here; there is no irrigation, and this crop has never needed spraying.
